name: Zoom AI On-Prem
desc: Zoom AI deployed inside your own data center or private cloud.
desc_zh: 部署在自有数据中心或私有云里的 Zoom AI
solves: Regulated teams were told to choose between Zoom's AI and data residency. This runs the same capabilities on infrastructure the customer controls, starting with speech recognition.
solves_zh: 受监管团队过去只能在 Zoom 的 AI 和数据不出境之间二选一。这套方案把能力跑在客户自己的基础设施上。
best_for: Security review blocks the cloud AI add-on and the meeting data cannot leave your network.
best_for_zh: 安全评审否掉了云端 AI 组件，而会议数据不允许离开公司网络。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.zoom.com/en/products/whats-new/ (product timeline, June 2026), t）。 Announced 2026-06-22 in the same post as the ZoomMate AI agents launch. The What's New timeline describes it as deploying Zoom AI on your own infrastructure or private cloud, starting with speech recognition and expanding later to AI summaries and agentic search, with Zoom handling updates and orchestration. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://news.zoom.com/zoom-introduces-ai-agents-as-part-of-zoommate-and-zoom-ai-on-prem-for-regulated-enterprises
